items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (buildWindowSpec, windowSql, resolvedSpec). But the new public `.window()` methods have no JSDoc, while every neighbouring builder method (orderBy, limit) is documented. Loops use a cryptic `for (const w of windows)`.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The spec builder is shared, but the name checks ('non-empty'/'whitespace') and the Proxy spec resolution are copy-pasted into 10 places (SelectBuilder and SelectQueryBuilderBase in 5 dialects), against the shared-helper convention. The extra windows plumbing through constructors also adds coupling.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Window names are type-checked, rejected when empty, and rejected when whitespace-only, with the required messages. Hidden tests pass 130/130, covering the frame and ntile validation constraints. No errors are swallowed and no magic constants were found.

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: Changes are additive: an optional `windows?` field on each *SelectConfig, the WINDOW clause is only emitted when `windows.length > 0`, and `.window()` is on all 5 dialects. Extra `.window()` on SelectBuilder is also additive. P2P 566/566 pass.
